title: Skeleton in Enchanted Forest
prompt: A highly detailed skeleton wearing a rich maroon velvet suit with white ruffled shirt and floral lapel, ornate silver and blue metallic helmet with glowing blue eyes, sits casually on a mossy tree stump in an ancient forest.
